LEVIui - Interactive Shiny GUI for levi

Source: R/LEVIui.R
LEVIui.Rd

Launch the levi graphical user interface (GUI) locally via Shiny. The GUI exposes all parameters available in script mode and additionally provides:

  • Interactive brushable region selection on the landscape heatmap (returns gene scores for the selected area).

  • Gene search - type a gene symbol to highlight its position with a yellow circle on the landscape.

  • Peak label overlay (requires ggrepel).

  • Signal transformation mode selector (ratio, logfc, zscore) and logfc_k steepness control.

  • Interactive 3D surface (requires plotly), carrying the same significance boundary as the 2D map.

  • Permutation significance test with per-iteration progress bar.

  • Download buttons for the landscape plot, node score table, and peak/valley table (CSV).

LEVIui(browser = FALSE)

Arguments

browser

Logical. TRUE opens the app in the system web browser; FALSE (default) opens it in the RStudio Viewer pane.

Value

Runs the Shiny application; does not return an R value.

Details

The GUI is a full-featured interface to levi. All file uploads, parameter sliders, and result downloads are handled interactively. For reproducible, automated, or batch analyses use levi directly in script mode.

The app is located in inst/shiny/ and can also be launched with shiny::runApp(system.file("shiny", package = "levi")).

See also

levi, readExpColumn

Author

Jose Rafael Pilan rafael.pilan@unesp.br, Isabelle Mira da Silva

Examples

if (interactive()) {
    LEVIui(browser = FALSE)   # opens in RStudio Viewer
    LEVIui(browser = TRUE)    # opens in system browser
}
